title: Stability of the $L^{p}$-Poincaré inequality for the Lebesgue measure and Gaussian probability measure with explicit geometric dependence and applications to spectral gaps
summary: In this paper, we obtain stability results for the $L^{p}$-Poincaré inequality for both Lebesgue measure and Gaussian probability measure (Theorem 3.3 and Theorem 3.13) that involve explicit dependence on the geometry of the domain. As a byproduct, the explicit constant allows us to recover important results of Yu, Zhong [YZ86] and Smits [Smi96] (Corollary 3.9), related to the fundamental gap conjecture of the Laplacian (resolved by Andrews and Clutterbuck [AC11]), thereby providing an alternative proof.
